metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Safeguard H (centripetal classifier): does consociational/affirmative-action institutional design (the New Economic Policy + federal bargain) sustain plural-society unity despite deep ethnic cleavage? Moderate-and-rising P1 plus centripetal design predicts maintained unity, NOT coercive suppression.
metadata.notes: Reference-based record: indicators resolved live via mi.datasource. The retained federation (post-1965 Singapore exit, already covered as case07). resolved_scores carry MI v2 re-scored pillars.

pre_event.event_description: Plural-society federation (1957 independence, 1963 federation) measured after a generation of NEP affirmative-action design intended to manage Malay/Chinese/Indian cleavage following the 1969 communal riots.

context.neighbor_details: Managed regional relations; minor southern-Thailand insurgency spillover.

Malaysia.notes: Indicators resolved via mi.datasource (Malaysia, 1996 -> 2024). Centripetal design = New Economic Policy (Bumiputera affirmative action) + federal Sabah/Sarawak autonomy + consociational Barisan Nasional coalition. Safeguard H (centripetal), not suppression.

a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Pre-P1 0.623 (upper-middle) with centripetal design; predicts continuity rather than collapse or breakout.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Malaysia drops a tier or experiences institutional collapse.

b_violence.prediction: Low communal-violence risk; institutional design contains the 1969-type cleavage.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: If any strain, on P2 (political openness / distributional distortions of NEP and one-coalition dominance).
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Strain concentrates on a non-P2 dimension.

e_fragment_count.prediction: No fragmentation; federation holds (Sabah/Sarawak autonomy managed within the federation).
e_fragment_count.falsification_condition: Secession of a state or federation breakup.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Moderate but contained reversal risk under long single-coalition dominance; alternation possible.
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: Authoritarian reversal / breakdown of electoral competition.

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: Centripetal federation / consociational design (Safeguard H) -- fragmentation MANAGEMENT, not coercive suppression.
g_suppression_mechanism.falsification_condition: Unity maintained primarily by coercive suppression rather than design/co-optation.

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Low sub-state turbulence; Sabah/Sarawak grievances channeled politically, minor border spillover only.

Malaysia.outcome_summary: P1 0.623->0.619 (flat); MI 0.709->0.681 (Tier 2 maintained). Federation held intact; first-ever electoral turnover in 2018 (BN ousted after six decades), further peaceful transitions 2020/2022 -- unity sustained via design and electoral channels, not communal violence. P2 declined 0.746->0.592.

b_violence.evidence: No recurrence of communal violence; 2018/2022 transitions peaceful.
b_violence.explanation: Low violence risk realized; design contained the cleavage.
b_violence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28: focus=Malaysia pre-P1=0.623 -> LOW risk (MI v1, anchored)

d_failure_dimension.evidence: P2 fell 0.746->0.592, the largest pillar decline.
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Strain concentrated on political-openness pillar as predicted; post-hoc dimension call coded PARTIAL.
d_failure_dimension.computed_config: Malaysia: P4=0.77, P2=0.75, P5=0.72, P3=0.68, P1=0.62 | all pillars >= median -> no binding vulnerability (management-load/high-capacity case; relatively-lowest P1=0.62)

e_fragment_count.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

f_reversal_risk.evidence: 2018 peaceful alternation ended single-coalition dominance without breakdown.
f_reversal_risk.explanation: Reversal risk stayed contained; competition deepened rather than collapsed.
f_reversal_risk.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

g_suppression.evidence: Unity sustained via consociational coalition + NEP design + electoral alternation, not coercion.
g_suppression.explanation: Centripetal classification (Safeguard H) holds; not a suppression case.
g_suppression.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

h_turbulence.evidence: Sabah/Sarawak grievances channeled politically (MA63 negotiations); no sustained armed turbulence.
h_turbulence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

analysis.overall_assessment: Clean centripetal-design success; moderate-high P1 plus consociational/affirmative-action design sustained plural-society unity through a historic 2018 alternation.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Institutional design (centripetal federation + NEP) is a distinct fragmentation-management path from coercive suppression -- Safeguard H, not the suppression tiers.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
